digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler field symmetry and property testing
propositions: Reconciler field asymmetry policies are scattered across multiple call sites without a single declarative source, causing parity bugs to escape detection
A new _field_contract.py registry module must enumerate all reconciled fields with their symmetry class (bidirectional-roundtrip, add-wins, or one-way-with-propagation-gate) and codec/gate references
Property tests must be parameterized off the registry and include a coverage guard that fails collection if any field handled by inbound_differ/apply_inbound_records lacks a registry entry
Per-symmetry-class property tests must assert roundtrip identity for bidirectional codecs, merge idempotence for add-wins fields, and gate consistency for one-way-gated fields through real call paths
The registry declaration and property test coverage must remain additive with no call-site rewiring or transport refactoring in scope
